evals.name: typical-mixed-week
evals.prompt: We just wrapped up the week. Can you put together a Slack update I can paste into our #product channel summarizing what shipped on main over the past week? Repo is at the provided path.
evals.expected_output: A copy-paste Slack message in a fenced code block, grouped into stakeholder sections (New & improved / Fixes), using Slack composer markdown (*bold*, - bullets, raw URLs), with internal refactor/chore/test commits dropped and changes rewritten in plain language.

evals.name: noisy-internal-only-week
evals.prompt: Generate the weekly shipped-changes Slack message from the git history of this repo's default branch over the last 7 days.
evals.expected_output: A Slack message that, when the week is mostly internal work, drops the internal commits and either surfaces only the genuinely user-facing changes or states plainly that no customer-facing changes shipped, rather than padding with refactors/chores.
